### CanvasTooltipComponent

File: `src/app/shared/canvas/tooltip/canvas-tooltip.component.ts`
Selector: `awg-canvas-tooltip`
Standalone: yes
Change detection: `ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush`

Description: The CanvasTooltip component. It shows a tooltip with a given text at a given point of a canvas (in css pixels), e.g. for the node under the pointer. It is placed next to the canvas inside its positioned container.

Inputs:
- `point: CanvasPoint | undefined` — Readonly input signal: point. It holds the point of the canvas to show the tooltip at, if any.
- `text: string | undefined` — Readonly input signal: text. It holds the text of the tooltip; without a text or a point, the tooltip is closed.

Properties:
- `tooltip: unknown = viewChild.required(NgbTooltip)` — Readonly view child signal: tooltip. It holds the tooltip at the anchor (opened and closed manually).

Methods:
- `_updateTooltip(isShown: boolean): void` — Private method: \_updateTooltip. It closes the tooltip and opens it again if it is shown, so that it is positioned at the current position of its anchor.

Description: The CodeMirror component. It contains a CodeMirror editor instance with two-way binding of its content.

Inputs:

- `mode: CmMode` — Readonly input signal: mode. It holds the mode of the codemirror editor.

Outputs:
- `content: string = ''` — Readonly model signal: content. It holds the content of the codemirror editor. Changes from the editor are emitted via contentChange .

Properties:
- `_destroyRef: unknown = inject(DestroyRef)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_destroyRef. It keeps the DestroyRef to clean up the editor view.
- `_editor: EditorView | undefined` — Private variable: \_editor. It keeps the EditorView instance.
- `codemirrorhost: unknown = viewChild.required<ElementRef<HTMLDivElement>>('codemirrorhost')` — Readonly view child signal: codemirrorhost. It holds the reference to the host element of the codemirror editor.

Methods:
- `init(state: EditorState): void` — Public method: init. It initializes the CodeMirror editor view with a given state.
- `onContentChange(content: string): void` — Public method: onContentChange. It listens for a change of the editor content and sets it on the content model signal.

### EditionFoliosViewerSvgComponent

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-sheets/edition-folios-panel/viewer/svg/edition-folios-viewer-svg.component.ts`
Selector: `awg-edition-folios-viewer-svg`
Standalone: yes
Change detection: `ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush`

Description: The EditionFoliosViewerSvg component. It contains the svg of a single folio of the folios viewer of the edition view of the app and renders that folio with its content segments.

Inputs:
- `folio: Folio` — Readonly input signal: folio. It holds the folio to be rendered.
- `selectedSvgSheet: EditionSvgSheetSelection | undefined` — Readonly input signal: selectedSvgSheet. It holds the selected svg sheet (id, full id and selected content).

Properties:
- `_editionModalService: unknown = inject(EditionModalService)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_editionModalService. It keeps the instance of the injected EditionModalService.
- `_folioDrawingService: unknown = inject(EditionFolioDrawingService)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_folioDrawingService. It keeps the instance of the injected EditionFolioDrawingService.
- `_folioSegmentService: unknown = inject(EditionFolioSegmentService)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_folioSegmentService. It keeps the instance of the injected EditionFolioSegmentService.
- `_navigationService: unknown = inject(EditionNavigationService)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_navigationService. It keeps the instance of the injected EditionNavigationService.
- `_svgRootGroupSelection: unknown = computed<D3Selection>(() => D3_SELECTION.select(this.svgRootGroup().nativeElement) )` — Private readonly computed signal: \_svgRootGroupSelection. It holds the d3 selection of the svg root group (the element is stable across renderings).
- `folioSvgData: unknown = computed<FolioSvgData>(() => this._folioDrawingService.getFolioSvgData(this.folio()))` — Readonly computed signal: folioSvgData. It holds the svg data (incl. the viewbox) of the folio.
- `selectedSegmentId: unknown = computed<string>(() => this.selectedSvgSheet()?.fullId ?? '')` — Readonly computed signal: selectedSegmentId. It holds the content segment id of the selected svg sheet, i.e. its full id (incl. partial).
- `svgRootGroup: unknown = viewChild.required<ElementRef<SVGGElement>>('svgRootGroup')` — Readonly view child signal: svgRootGroup. It holds the reference to the root group of the folio svg.

Template variables:
- `viewBox` = `folioSvgData().viewBox`

Methods:
- `_renderFolio(rootGroupSelection: D3Selection, svgData: FolioSvgData): void` — Private method: \_renderFolio. It renders the given folio svg data into the given svg root group selection and marks the content segment of the selected svg sheet as active.
- `onFolioSelect(event: Event): void` — Public method: onFolioSelect. It handles a click or an Enter/Space keydown on the folio svg (delegated from the svg element): selecting a selectable content segment navigates to its svg sheet, selecting any other content segment opens its text modal.

- `viewData: unknown = this._editionViewService.sheetsViewData` — Readonly signal: viewData. It holds the state of the sheets view data.

- `onOverlaySelect(overlays: EditionSvgOverlayTkk[]): void` — Public method: onOverlaySelect. It sets the selected tkk overlays (that filter the commentary of the displayed textcritics).
- `onSheetBrowse(direction: "1" | unknown): void` — Public method: onSheetBrowse. It evaluates the id of the previous or next SVG sheet of the same edition type based on the given direction and selects it with \_selectSvgSheet.

- `svgSheetsData: EditionSvgSheetsList | null` — Readonly input signal: svgSheetsData. It holds the svg sheets data.

Outputs:
- `browseSheetRequest: 1 | -1` — Readonly output signal: browseSheetRequest. It emits the direction (-1 for previous, 1 for next) to browse the svg sheets.
- `isSheetFacetMinimized: boolean` — Readonly model signal: isSheetFacetMinimized. It holds the toggle state of the sheet facet (two-way bound).
- `selectLinkBoxRequest: string` — Readonly output signal: selectLinkBoxRequest. It emits the id of a selected link box.
- `selectTkkOverlaysRequest: EditionSvgOverlayTkk[]` — Readonly output signal: selectTkkOverlaysRequest. It emits the selected tkk overlays.

- `toggleAll(): void` — Public method: toggleAll. It shows all editorial additions, or hides them if all are visible already, and emits each change.

### EditionSheetViewerSvgComponent

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-sheets/edition-sheets-panel/viewer/svg/edition-sheet-viewer-svg.component.ts`
Selector: `awg-edition-sheet-viewer-svg`
Standalone: yes
Change detection: `ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush`

Description: The EditionSheetViewerSvg component. It contains the svg of a single svg sheet of the edition view of the app and renders that svg sheet with its overlays, zoom and editorial additions.

Inputs:
- `selectedSvgSheet: EditionSvgSheetSelection` — Readonly input signal: selectedSvgSheet. It holds the selected svg sheet (id, full id and selected content).
- `zoomConfig: ZoomConfig` — Readonly input signal: zoomConfig. It holds the configuration of the svg zoom.
- `zoomValue: number` — Readonly model signal: zoomValue. It holds the current zoom factor of the svg sheet (two-way bound).

Outputs:
- `selectLinkBoxRequest: string` — Readonly output signal: selectLinkBoxRequest. It emits the id of a selected link box.
- `selectTkkOverlaysRequest: EditionSvgOverlayTkk[]` — Readonly output signal: selectTkkOverlaysRequest. It emits the selected tkk overlays.
- `zoomValue: number` — Readonly model signal: zoomValue. It holds the current zoom factor of the svg sheet (two-way bound).

Properties:
- `_renderQueue: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve()` — Private variable: \_renderQueue. It keeps the promise chain of the sheet renderings (renderings never overlap, outdated sheets are skipped).
- `_svgDrawingService: unknown = inject(EditionSvgDrawingService)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_svgDrawingService. It keeps the instance of the injected EditionSvgDrawingService.
- `_svgOverlayService: unknown = inject(EditionSvgOverlayService)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_svgOverlayService. It keeps the instance of the injected EditionSvgOverlayService.
- `_svgRootGroupSelection: unknown = computed<D3Selection>(() => D3_SELECTION.select(this.svgRootGroup().nativeElement) )` — Private readonly computed signal: \_svgRootGroupSelection. It holds the d3 selection of the svg root group (the element is stable across renderings).
- `selectedTkkOverlays: unknown = computed<EditionSvgOverlayTkk[]>(() => this._svgOverlayService.getSelectedTkkOverlays(this.svgOverlaysState()) )` — Readonly computed signal: selectedTkkOverlays. It holds the selected tkk overlays (including all parts of multi-part overlays).
- `suppliedClasses: unknown = signal<string[]>([])` — Readonly signal: suppliedClasses. It holds the names of the supplied classes of the svg sheet.
- `svg: unknown = viewChild.required<ElementRef<SVGSVGElement>>('svg')` — Readonly view child signal: svg. It holds the reference to the svg element of the sheet.
- `svgOverlaysState: unknown = signal<EditionSvgOverlaysState>(this._svgOverlayService.createSvgOverlaysState())` — Readonly signal: svgOverlaysState. It holds the state of the svg overlays of the rendered svg sheet (available tkk overlays, selection, hover and highlighting).
- `svgRootGroup: unknown = viewChild.required<ElementRef<SVGGElement>>('svgRootGroup')` — Readonly view child signal: svgRootGroup. It holds the reference to the root group of the svg sheet.
- `svgZoom: unknown = viewChild.required(SvgZoomDirective)` — Readonly view child signal: svgZoom. It holds the svg zoom directive of the svg sheet.

Template variables:
- `hasTkkOverlays` = `svgOverlaysState().tkkOverlays.length > 0`
- `hasSuppliedClasses` = `suppliedClasses().length > 0`
- `hasAdditions` = `hasTkkOverlays || hasSuppliedClasses`

Methods:
- `_clearSheet(): void` — Private method: \_clearSheet. It removes the content of the previously rendered svg sheet and resets the overlay state and the supplied classes.
- `_queueRendering(sheet: EditionSvgSheetSelection): void` — Private method: \_queueRendering. It queues the rendering of a given svg sheet after the previous rendering. The rendering is skipped if the sheet is no longer selected by then.
- `_renderSheet(sheet: EditionSvgSheetSelection): Promise<void>` — Private method: \_renderSheet. It renders a given svg sheet with its overlays and supplied classes, and resets the zoom.
- `_updateTkkOverlaysSelection(transition: function): void` — Private method: \_updateTkkOverlaysSelection. It updates the state of the tkk overlays with the given state transition and emits the selected tkk overlays if the selection has changed.
- `onAdditionVisibilityChange(: EditionSheetViewerAdditionsPanelChange): void` — Public method: onAdditionVisibilityChange. It sets the visibility of an editorial addition of the svg sheet as requested by the additions panel: the tkk key sets the highlighting of the tkk overlays (hiding them also clears their selection), any other key sets the opacity of the supplied class with that name.
- `onSheetHighlight(target: EventTarget | null): void` — Public method: onSheetHighlight. It sets the highlighted (hovered or focused) tkk overlay from the target of a pointerover or focusin on the svg sheet (delegated from the svg element), or resets it for no target (pointerleave or focusout).
- `onSheetSelect(event: Event): void` — Public method: onSheetSelect. It handles a click or an Enter/Space keydown on the svg sheet (delegated from the svg element): selecting a link box emits its id, selecting a tkk overlay toggles its selection and emits the selected tkk overlays.
- `resetZoom(): void` — Public method: resetZoom. It resets the zoom of the svg sheet via the svg zoom directive.

### ForceGraphCanvasComponent

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/canvas/force-graph-canvas.component.ts`
Selector: `awg-force-graph-canvas`
Standalone: yes
Change detection: `ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush`

Description: The ForceGraphCanvas component. It contains the canvas of the ForceGraphComponent: it lays out the result graph, draws it, and supports zoom, node drag and node clicks.

Inputs:
- `resultGraph: ResultGraph` — Readonly input signal: resultGraph. It holds the (limited) result graph to be drawn.
- `zoomConfig: ZoomConfig` — Readonly input signal: zoomConfig. It holds the zoom configuration (initial, min, max, step size).
- `zoomValue: number` — Readonly model signal: zoomValue. It holds the current zoom factor of the graph.

Outputs:
- `clickedNodeRequest: ResultGraphNode` — Readonly output signal: clickedNodeRequest. It emits the node of the result graph the user clicked on.
- `zoomValue: number` — Readonly model signal: zoomValue. It holds the current zoom factor of the graph.

Properties:
- `_canvasService: unknown = inject(ForceGraphCanvasService)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_canvasService. It keeps the instance of the injected ForceGraphCanvasService.
- `_canvasView: unknown = computed<ForceGraphCanvasView>(() => ({ transform: this.canvasZoom().transform(), viewport: this.canvasViewport().viewport(), }))` — Private readonly computed signal: \_canvasView. It holds the current view onto the graph (zoom transform and viewport of the canvas).
- `_destroyRef: unknown = inject(DestroyRef)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_destroyRef. It keeps the instance of the injected DestroyRef.
- `_drawnView: ForceGraphCanvasView | undefined` — Private variable: \_drawnView. It keeps the view of the last drawing, if any.
- `_drawScheduler: unknown = CANVAS_UTILS.createFrameScheduler(() => this._draw(), this._destroyRef)` — Private readonly variable: \_drawScheduler. It keeps the scheduler of the drawings (at most one per animation frame).
- `_simulationPin: unknown = new ForceGraphSimulationPin()` — Private readonly variable: \_simulationPin. It keeps the pin of the dragged node for the running simulation.
- `_simulationService: unknown = inject(ForceGraphSimulationService)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_simulationService. It keeps the instance of the injected ForceGraphSimulationService.
- `_simulationSubscription: Subscription | undefined` — Private variable: \_simulationSubscription. It keeps the subscription of the running simulation.
- ``ariaLabel: unknown = computed<string>(() => { const { nodes, edges } = this.resultGraph(); return `Graph mit ${nodes.length} Knoten und ${edges.length} Kanten. Eine textuelle Darste…`` — Readonly computed signal: ariaLabel. It holds the accessible name of the canvas.
- `canvas: unknown = viewChild.required<ElementRef<HTMLCanvasElement>>('canvas')` — Readonly view child signal: canvas. It holds the reference to the canvas element of the graph.
- `canvasViewport: unknown = viewChild.required(CanvasViewportDirective)` — Readonly view child signal: canvasViewport. It holds the canvas viewport directive of the graph (size and device pixel ratio of the canvas).
- `canvasZoom: unknown = viewChild.required(CanvasZoomDirective)` — Readonly view child signal: canvasZoom. It holds the canvas zoom directive of the graph.
- `dragSubject: CanvasDragSubjectAccessor<ForceGraphVisibleNode> = () => {...}` — Public readonly method: dragSubject. It finds the drag subject of the canvas drag: the visible node at a given point, if any (none while loading).
- `forceGraphData: unknown = linkedSignal<ResultGraph, ForceGraphData>({ source: this.resultGraph, computation: (resultGraph, previous) => { const forceGraphData = FORCE_GRAPH_UTILS.toForce…` — Readonly linked signal: forceGraphData. It holds the force graph data of the result graph, with the positions restored from its previous value.
- `hoveredNode: unknown = signal<ForceGraphCanvasHoveredNode | undefined>(undefined)` — Readonly signal: hoveredNode. It holds the node under the pointer (with the position of its tooltip), if any.
- `isLayoutLoading: unknown = signal<boolean>(false)` — Readonly signal: isLayoutLoading. It holds the flag if the graph is laid out behind the loading spinner.
- `zoomFilter: CanvasZoomFilter = () => {...}` — Public readonly method: zoomFilter. It filters the start of the canvas zoom: a pointer-down on a node starts a drag instead of a pan.

Template variables:
- `hovered` = `hoveredNode()`

Methods:
- `_draw(): void` — Private method: \_draw. It draws the force graph data with the current zoom transform and viewport, and keeps that view.
- `_findVisibleNodeAtEvent(event: MouseEvent | TouchEvent): ForceGraphVisibleNode | undefined` — Private method: \_findVisibleNodeAtEvent. It finds the visible node at the point of the canvas of a given mouse or touch event, if any.
- `_findVisibleNodeAtPoint(point: CanvasPoint): ForceGraphVisibleNode | undefined` — Private method: \_findVisibleNodeAtPoint. It finds the visible node at a given point of the canvas (in css pixels), if any.
- `_startSimulation(graphData: ForceGraphData): void` — Private method: \_startSimulation. It (re)starts the simulation of the given data and draws each result. The spinner shows until the layout is calm; then a large graph is zoomed to fit.
- `_toHoveredNode(node: ForceGraphVisibleNode): ForceGraphCanvasHoveredNode` — Private method: \_toHoveredNode. It gets the given node as hovered node, with the point of its tooltip at the node on the canvas.
- `onCanvasResize(): void` — Public method: onCanvasResize. It draws the graph at once after a resize of the canvas (which has cleared it), before the next paint.
- `onMouseLeave(): void` — Public method: onMouseLeave. It clears the hovered node when the mouse leaves the canvas.
- `onMouseMove(event: MouseEvent): void` — Public method: onMouseMove. It sets the hovered node (with the point of its tooltip at the node) when the mouse moves over the canvas.
- `onNodeClick(event: MouseEvent): void` — Public method: onNodeClick. It handles a click on the canvas and emits the node of the result graph at the click position, if any. Clicks after dragging a node or panning are suppressed by d3 itself.
- `onNodeDrag(: CanvasDragMove<ForceGraphVisibleNode>): void` — Public method: onNodeDrag. It pins the dragged node at the current point of the pointer, so that its neighbours follow, and redraws the graph.
- `onNodeDragEnd(node: ForceGraphVisibleNode): void` — Public method: onNodeDragEnd. It releases the dragged node, so that the graph settles again.
- `resetZoom(): void` — Public method: resetZoom. It resets the zoom of the graph via the canvas zoom directive.
- `zoomToFit(): void` — Public method: zoomToFit. It zooms the canvas to fit the area covered by the positioned nodes of the graph (converted into canvas coordinates without zoom).

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/graph-visualizer.component.ts`
Selector: `awg-graph-visualizer`
Standalone: yes
Change detection: `ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush`

Description: The GraphVisualizer component. It contains panels to input RDF triples and a SPARQL query and to visualize a graph via the ForceGraphComponent.

Inputs:
- `isFullscreenMode: boolean = false` — Readonly input signal: isFullscreenMode. It holds a boolean flag if fullscreenMode is active.
- `rdfData: GraphRdfData` — Readonly input signal: rdfData. It holds the RDF data (triples and queries) of the graph.

Properties:
- `_queryRequest: unknown = linkedSignal<GraphRdfData, SparqlQueryRequest>({ source: this.rdfData, computation: () => untracked(() => this._createQueryRequest()), })` — Private readonly linked signal: \_queryRequest. It holds the latest requested query (reset to the current query and triples on input change, which are reset themselves). Only performQuery requests a new run, not edits of query or triples.
- `_runnableRequest: unknown = computed<SparqlQueryRequest | undefined>(() => { const request = this._queryRequest(); return GRAPH_QUERY_UTILS.isRunnableQueryType(request.queryType) ? request…` — Private readonly computed signal: \_runnableRequest. It holds the latest requested query if it can be run (only construct and select queries for now), otherwise undefined.
- `_sparqlQueryService: unknown = inject(SparqlQueryService)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_sparqlQueryService. It keeps the instance of the injected SparqlQueryService.
- `_toastService: unknown = inject(ToastService)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_toastService. It keeps the instance of the injected ToastService.
- `defaultForceGraphHeight: number = 500` — Readonly variable: defaultForceGraphHeight. It keeps the default height for the force graph.
- `query: unknown = linkedSignal<GraphQuery>(() => GRAPH_QUERY_UTILS.initialQuery(this.queryList()))` — Readonly linked signal: query. It holds the query of the graph visualization (reset to the first query of the query list whenever it changes).
- `queryList: unknown = computed(() => this.rdfData().queryList)` — Readonly computed signal: queryList. It holds the query list from the RDF input data.
- `queryResult: unknown = computed<SparqlResult | undefined>(() => this.queryRun.isLoading() ? undefined : this.queryRun.value()?.result )` — Readonly computed signal: queryResult. It holds the result of the latest query run (undefined while the query is running).
- `queryRun: unknown = resource<SparqlQueryRun, SparqlQueryRequest | undefined>({ params: () => this._runnableRequest(), loader: ({ params, abortSignal }) => this._runQuery(params, ab…` — Readonly resource: queryRun. It holds the run of the latest requested query. Stale runs are cancelled when a new query is requested. Note: resource is still experimental in Angular.
- `queryTime: unknown = computed(() => this.queryRun.value()?.durationMs ?? 0)` — Readonly computed signal: queryTime. It holds the duration of the latest query run.
- `triples: unknown = linkedSignal(() => this.rdfData().triples)` — Readonly linked signal: triples. It holds the triples of the graph visualization (reset to the triples from the RDF input data whenever they change).

Template variables:
- `isFullscreen` = `isFullscreenMode()`
- `currentQuery` = `query()`
- `isConstructQuery` = `currentQuery.queryType === 'construct'`
- `isSelectQuery` = `currentQuery.queryType === 'select'`

Methods:
- `_createQueryRequest(): SparqlQueryRequest` — Private method: \_createQueryRequest. It creates a request of the current query against the current triples.
- `_runQuery(request: SparqlQueryRequest, abortSignal: AbortSignal): Promise<SparqlQueryRun>` — Private method: \_runQuery. It runs a requested query and shows the completed query in the editor (unless edited meanwhile). On errors, it logs, shows a toast and returns an empty result. Cancelled runs have no side effects.
- `onGraphNodeClick(node: ResultGraphNode): void` — Public method: onGraphClick. It is called when a node in the graph is clicked.
- `onTableNodeClick(URI: string): void` — Public method: onTableNodeClick. It performs a query for a given URI from the result table.
- `performQuery(): void` — Public method: performQuery. It requests a run of the current query against the current triples.
- `resetQuery(query?: GraphQuery): void` — Public method: resetQuery. It resets a given query to its initial value if it is known from the query list (or to the first query of the list if no query is given), and performs it.
- `resetTriples(): void` — Public method: resetTriples. It resets the triples to the triples from the RDF input data.
- `showToastMessage(toastMessage: ToastMessage, type: "error" | "info" = 'info'): void` — Public method: showToastMessage. It shows a given toast message with the specified type via the ToastService.

### TableComponent

File: `src/app/shared/table/table.component.ts`
Selector: `awg-table`
Standalone: yes
Change detection: `ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush`

Description: The Table component. It contains a generic table with search filter, sortable columns and pagination.

Inputs:
- `headerInputData: readonly string[] = []` — Readonly input signal: headerInputData. It holds the header labels of the table.
- `rowInputData: TableRow[] = []` — Readonly input signal: rowInputData. It holds the rows of the table.
- `tableTitle: string = ''` — Readonly input signal: tableTitle. It holds the title of the table.

Outputs:
- `clickedTableRowRequest: Event` — Readonly output signal: clickedTableRowRequest. It emits the event of a clicked table row.
- `clickedTableValueRequest: string` — Readonly output signal: clickedTableValueRequest. It emits the value of a clicked table cell.

Properties:
- `filteredRows: unknown = computed(() => filterTableRows(this.totalRows(), this.searchFilter()))` — Readonly computed signal: filteredRows. It holds the rows filtered by the search filter.
- `page: unknown = signal<number>(1)` — Readonly signal: page. It holds the current page of the pagination.
- `pageSize: unknown = signal<number>(TABLE_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE)` — Readonly signal: pageSize. It holds the number of rows per page.
- `pageSizeOptions: unknown = TABLE_PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS` — Readonly variable: pageSizeOptions. It keeps the selectable page sizes.
- `paginatedRows: unknown = computed(() => paginateTableRows(this.sortedRows(), this.page(), this.pageSize()))` — Readonly computed signal: paginatedRows. It holds the sorted rows of the current page.
- `searchFilter: unknown = signal<string>('')` — Readonly signal: searchFilter. It holds the search term to filter the rows.
- `sortedRows: unknown = computed(() => { const { key, reverse } = this.sortState(); return sortTableRows(this.filteredRows(), key, reverse); })` — Readonly computed signal: sortedRows. It holds the filtered rows sorted by the sort state.
- `sortIcon: unknown = computed(() => (this.sortState().reverse ? faSortUp : faSortDown))` — Readonly computed signal: sortIcon. It holds the icon for the current sort order.
- `sortState: unknown = linkedSignal<TableSortState>(() => ({ key: this.headerInputData()[0] ?? '', reverse: false, }))` — Readonly linked signal: sortState. It holds the sort state of the table. It is reset to the first header label when the header changes.
- `totalRows: unknown = computed(() => this.rowInputData() ?? [])` — Readonly computed signal: totalRows. It holds all rows of the table, or an empty array if no rows are given.

Template variables:
- `cell` = `row[headerLabel]`

Methods:
- `onPageSizeChange(pageSize: number): void` — Public method: onPageSizeChange. It sets the given page size and resets the page.
- `onSearchFilterChange(term: string): void` — Public method: onSearchFilterChange. It sets the given search term and resets the page.
- `onSort(key: string): void` — Public method: onSort. It sorts the table by the given key (header label). Sorting by the current key again reverses the sort order.
- `onTableRowClick(event: Event): void` — Public method: onTableRowClick. It emits the event of a clicked table row.
- `onTableValueClick(value: string): void` — Public method: onTableValueClick. It emits the value of a clicked table cell.

## Directives

### AbbrDirective

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/shared/abbr/abbr.directive.ts`
Selector: `[awgAbbr]`
Standalone: yes

Description: The abbr directive. It is used to create an abbreviation element.

Inputs:
- `awgAbbr: string = ''` — Readonly input signal: text. It holds the text value with a possible abbreviation.

Properties:
- `_elementRef: unknown = inject<ElementRef<HTMLElement>>(ElementRef)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_elementRef. It keeps the reference to the host element.

Methods:
- `_replaceAbbreviations(): void` — Private method: \_replaceAbbreviations. It replaces abbreviations in the text with abbreviation elements containing the full form as title.

### CanvasDragDirective

File: `src/app/shared/canvas/drag/canvas-drag.directive.ts`
Selector: `canvas[awgCanvasDrag]`
Standalone: yes

Description: The CanvasDrag directive. It binds a d3 drag behaviour to the host canvas and emits every move and the end of a drag. Only gestures starting on a dragSubject are drags (others are left, e.g., to a pan), one touch at a time.

Inputs:
- `dragSubject: CanvasDragSubjectAccessor<T>` — Readonly input signal: dragSubject. It holds the accessor that finds the drag subject at a given point of the canvas.

Outputs:
- `dragEnd: T` — Readonly output signal: dragEnd. It emits the subject when a drag ends (a gesture with at least one move).
- `dragMove: CanvasDragMove<T>` — Readonly output signal: dragMove. It emits the subject and the current point of the pointer on every move of a drag.

Properties:
- `_activeGesture: CanvasDragGesture<T> | undefined` — Private variable: \_activeGesture. It keeps the gesture of the running drag, if any.
- `_canvas: unknown = D3_SELECTION.select<HTMLCanvasElement, unknown>(this._canvasEl)` — Private readonly variable: \_canvas. It keeps the D3 selection of the host canvas element.
- `_canvasEl: unknown = this._elementRef.nativeElement` — Private readonly variable: \_canvasEl. It keeps the host canvas element.
- `_dragBehaviour: unknown = D3_DRAG.drag<HTMLCanvasElement, unknown, CanvasDragGesture<T>>() .container(() => this._canvasEl) // A gesture without subject is ignored by d3-drag, but its ty…` — Private readonly variable: \_dragBehaviour. It keeps the D3 drag behaviour bound to the host canvas element (pointer positions relative to the canvas itself).
- `_elementRef: unknown = inject<ElementRef<HTMLCanvasElement>>(ElementRef)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_elementRef. It keeps the reference to the host canvas element.

Methods:
- `_findGesture(event: CanvasDragEvent<T>): CanvasDragGesture | undefined` — Private method: \_findGesture. It finds the drag subject at the start point of a given gesture and wraps it (not moved yet). D3-drag ignores a gesture without subject, or a further touch during a drag (a mouse gesture replaces it).

### CanvasViewportDirective

File: `src/app/shared/canvas/viewport/canvas-viewport.directive.ts`
Selector: `canvas[awgCanvasViewport]`
Standalone: yes

Description: The CanvasViewport directive. It measures the size and device pixel ratio of the host canvas on every resize or change of the device pixel ratio and sizes its backing store to them (only on a change, then it emits resized ).

Outputs:
- `resized: CanvasViewport` — Readonly output signal: resized. It emits the new viewport when the backing store of the canvas has been resized (which clears the canvas, so it should be redrawn at once, before the next paint).

Properties:
- `_canvasEl: unknown = this._elementRef.nativeElement` — Private readonly variable: \_canvasEl. It keeps the host canvas element.
- `_destroyRef: unknown = inject(DestroyRef)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_destroyRef. It keeps the instance of the injected DestroyRef.
- `_elementRef: unknown = inject<ElementRef<HTMLCanvasElement>>(ElementRef)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_elementRef. It keeps the reference to the host canvas element.
- `_viewport: unknown = signal<CanvasViewport>({ width: 0, height: 0, dpr: 1 })` — Private readonly signal: \_viewport. It holds the current viewport of the canvas.
- `viewport: unknown = this._viewport.asReadonly()` — Readonly signal: viewport. It holds the current viewport of the canvas (readonly).

Methods:
- `_measure(): void` — Private method: \_measure. It sets the viewport to the rendered size of the canvas and the device pixel ratio, and sizes the backing store of the canvas accordingly, if it has changed (then it emits resized ).
- `_observeDevicePixelRatio(): void` — Private method: \_observeDevicePixelRatio. It remeasures the canvas on every change of the device pixel ratio (e.g. on another screen, without resize), renewing the media query of the current ratio each time (if matchMedia is available).
- `_observeResize(): void` — Private method: \_observeResize. It remeasures the canvas on every resize (also without a window resize, e.g. in fullscreen).

### CanvasZoomDirective

File: `src/app/shared/canvas/zoom/canvas-zoom.directive.ts`
Selector: `canvas[awgCanvasZoom]`
Standalone: yes

Description: The CanvasZoom directive. It binds a d3 pan and zoom behaviour to the host canvas and holds the transform in a signal (to redraw with); the zoom factor is synced two-way via zoomValue (cf. ZoomBaseDirective).

Inputs:
- `zoomFilter: CanvasZoomFilter = () => true` — Readonly input signal: zoomFilter. It holds an extra filter for the pointer events that may start a pan (default: all; wheel events always zoom).
- `zoomConfig: ZoomConfig` — Readonly input signal: zoomConfig. It holds the zoom configuration (initial, min, max, step size).
- `zoomValue: number` — Readonly model signal: zoomValue. It holds the current zoom factor (rounded to the step size of the zoom configuration).

Outputs:
- `zoomValue: number` — Readonly model signal: zoomValue. It holds the current zoom factor (rounded to the step size of the zoom configuration).

Properties:
- `_transform: unknown = signal<D3_ZOOM.ZoomTransform>(D3_ZOOM.zoomIdentity)` — Private readonly signal: \_transform. It holds the current zoom transform.
- `transform: unknown = this._transform.asReadonly()` — Readonly signal: transform. It holds the current zoom transform (readonly).
- `_elementRef: unknown = inject<ElementRef<E>>(ElementRef)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_elementRef. It keeps the reference to the host element.
- `_hostEl: unknown = this._elementRef.nativeElement` — Protected readonly variable: \_hostEl. It keeps the host element.
- `_selection: unknown = D3_SELECTION.select<E, unknown>(this._hostEl)` — Protected readonly variable: \_selection. It keeps the D3 selection of the host element.
- `_zoomBehaviour: unknown = D3_ZOOM.zoom<E, unknown>().on( 'zoom', (event: D3_ZOOM.D3ZoomEvent<E, unknown>) => this._onZoom(event.transform) )` — Protected readonly variable: \_zoomBehaviour. It keeps the D3 zoom behaviour bound to the host element.

Methods:
- `_applyTransform(transform: D3_ZOOM.ZoomTransform): void` — Protected method: \_applyTransform. It holds a given zoom transform.
- `_filter(event: MouseEvent | TouchEvent | WheelEvent): boolean` — Private method: \_filter. It decides if a given event may start a gesture: like d3's default filter (no secondary button, no ctrl+drag), wheel events always, other events only if the zoom filter accepts them.
- `zoomToFit(bounds: CanvasBounds, size: CanvasSize, padding: number = 20): void` — Public method: zoomToFit. It zooms and pans so that the given bounds (plus padding) fit centered into the canvas of the given size, with a scale between the minimum and the initial one; without a rendered canvas size, it does nothing. The size is given by the caller, so that the bounds and the fit refer to the same size of the canvas.
- `_onZoom(transform: D3_ZOOM.ZoomTransform): void` — Private method: \_onZoom. It applies a given zoom transform and sets the rounded zoom factor.
- `reset(): void` — Public method: reset. It resets the zoom to the initial scale and the origin (0,0).

### ClickDirective

File: `src/app/shared/click/click.directive.ts`
Selector: `[awgClick]`
Standalone: yes

Description: The click directive. It emits a click on its host element also for the keyboard: on click, on the Enter key and (except for links) on the Space key. Following the ARIA semantics, links ( \<a\> or role="link" ) are only activated by the Enter key, so the Space key is disabled for them by default. The keyboard is only emulated for targets that the browser does not activate itself (e.g., \<div\> , \<a\> without href or svg groups). Native controls and links with href (as host, as delegated target or as ancestor of the target within the host) emit only once through their synthesized click.

Inputs:
- `clickOnSpace = !isLinkElement(this._elementRef.nativeElement)` — Readonly input signal: clickOnSpace. It holds a boolean flag if the Space key emits a click (by default not for links).

Outputs:
- `awgClick: Event` — Readonly output signal: awgClick. It emits the click or keydown event that activated the host element.

Properties:
- `_elementRef: unknown = inject<ElementRef<Element>>(ElementRef)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_elementRef. It keeps the reference to the host element of the directive.

Methods:
- `_hasNativeActivation(target: EventTarget | null): boolean` — Private method: \_hasNativeActivation. It checks if a given event target is, or lies within, an element that the browser activates itself on the keyboard. Only ancestors within the host element are considered.
- `onEnter(event: Event): void` — Public method: onEnter. It emits a keydown of the Enter key as click, unless the browser activates the target itself.
- `onSpace(event: Event): void` — Public method: onSpace. It emits a keydown of the Space key as click, if enabled and unless the browser activates the target itself.

### CompileHtmlDirective

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/shared/compile-html/compile-html.directive.ts`

Standalone: yes

Description: The CompileHtmlDirective. It compiles and renders HTML content in the host element. It also emits events for clicks on specific elements within the compiled HTML.

- `_glyphService: unknown = inject(EditionGlyphService)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_glyphService It keeps the instance of the injected EditionGlyphService.
- `_navigationService: unknown = inject(EditionNavigationService)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_navigationService It keeps the instance of the injected EditionNavigationService.
- `_renderer: unknown = inject(Renderer2)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_renderer It keeps the instance of the injected Renderer2.

Methods:

- `_handleImageNavigation(img: HTMLImageElement, event: Event): void` — Private method: \_handleImageNavigation. It handles click events on image elements and calls the appropriate navigation methods from the EditionNavigationService.

- `_replaceGlyphPlaceholders(content: string): string` — Private method: \_replaceGlyphPlaceholders. It replaces placeholders in the content with the corresponding glyphs from the EditionGlyphService.
- `onHostClick(event: MouseEvent): void` — Protected method: onHostClick. It handles click events on the host element.
- `onHostKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent): void` — Protected method: onHostKeydown. It handles keydown events on the host element for Enter and Space keys.

### EditionSheetFacetScrollDirective

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-sheets/edition-sheets-panel/facet/scroll/edition-sheet-facet-scroll.directive.ts`
Selector: `[awgEditionSheetFacetScroll]`
Standalone: yes

Description: The EditionSheetFacetScroll directive. It keeps the active facet item visible inside a scrollable facet list by adjusting the scroll position of the list (without scrolling the page) whenever the trigger changes. It also provides the range of the currently visible facet items.

Inputs:
- `activeSelector: string = '.awg-edition-sheet-facet-item-link.active, .awg-edition-sheet-facet-item-link-dropdown-toggle.active'` — Readonly input signal: activeSelector. It holds the css selector of the active facet item inside the list.
- `itemSelector: string = 'awg-edition-sheet-facet-item'` — Readonly input signal: itemSelector. It holds the css selector of the facet items inside the list that are counted for the visible range.
- `awgEditionSheetFacetScroll: unknown` — Readonly input signal: trigger. It holds the value that triggers a new scroll check when it changes (e.g. the selected sheet id and the open state of the facet group).

Properties:
- `_elementRef: unknown = inject<ElementRef<HTMLElement>>(ElementRef)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_elementRef. It keeps the reference to the host element (the scrollable list).
- `visibleRange: unknown = signal<EditionSheetFacetVisibleRange | null>(null, { equal: (a, b) => a?.first === b?.first && a?.last === b?.last, })` — Readonly signal: visibleRange. It holds the range of the (at least partly) visible facet items, or null if the list does not scroll or contains no items. Equal ranges do not notify (avoids change detection on every scroll event).

Methods:
- `_getScrollTopForVisibleChild(scrollTop: number, viewportHeight: number, childTop: number, childHeight: number): number` — Private method: \_getScrollTopForVisibleChild. It calculates the scroll position of the list that makes the given child fully visible. The scroll position only changes if the child is (partly) outside the visible area.
- `_getVisibleRange(listTop: number, viewportHeight: number, itemRects: DOMRect[]): EditionSheetFacetVisibleRange | null` — Private method: \_getVisibleRange. It calculates the (1-based) positions of the first and last item that are at least partly inside the visible area of the list.
- `scrollActiveItemIntoView(): void` — Public method: scrollActiveItemIntoView. It adjusts the scroll position of the host list so that the active facet item is fully visible.
- `updateVisibleRange(): void` — Public method: updateVisibleRange. It updates the visibleRange with the range of the (at least partly) visible facet items of the host list.

- `resolvedRel: unknown = computed<string | null>(() => { const baseRel = this.rel(); if (!this.isExternal()) { return baseRel || null; } const relParts = new Set(baseRel.split(/\s+/).fi…` — Protected readonly computed signal: resolvedRel. It merges existing rel inputs with security attributes ('noopener noreferrer') for external links, or returns the original rel value for internal links.

### SvgZoomDirective

File: `src/app/shared/zoom/svg-zoom.directive.ts`
Selector: `svg[awgSvgZoom]`
Standalone: yes

Description: The SvgZoom directive. It binds a d3 pan and zoom behaviour to the host svg and applies the transform to a given target element; the zoom factor is synced two-way via zoomValue (cf. ZoomBaseDirective).

Inputs:
- `zoomTarget: Element` — Readonly input signal: zoomTarget. It holds the element that receives the zoom transform.
- `zoomConfig: ZoomConfig` — Readonly input signal: zoomConfig. It holds the zoom configuration (initial, min, max, step size).
- `zoomValue: number` — Readonly model signal: zoomValue. It holds the current zoom factor (rounded to the step size of the zoom configuration).

Outputs:
- `zoomValue: number` — Readonly model signal: zoomValue. It holds the current zoom factor (rounded to the step size of the zoom configuration).

Properties:
- `_elementRef: unknown = inject<ElementRef<E>>(ElementRef)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_elementRef. It keeps the reference to the host element.
- `_hostEl: unknown = this._elementRef.nativeElement` — Protected readonly variable: \_hostEl. It keeps the host element.
- `_selection: unknown = D3_SELECTION.select<E, unknown>(this._hostEl)` — Protected readonly variable: \_selection. It keeps the D3 selection of the host element.
- `_zoomBehaviour: unknown = D3_ZOOM.zoom<E, unknown>().on( 'zoom', (event: D3_ZOOM.D3ZoomEvent<E, unknown>) => this._onZoom(event.transform) )` — Protected readonly variable: \_zoomBehaviour. It keeps the D3 zoom behaviour bound to the host element.

Methods:
- `_applyTransform(transform: ZoomTransform): void` — Protected method: \_applyTransform. It applies a given zoom transform to the zoom target.
- `_onZoom(transform: D3_ZOOM.ZoomTransform): void` — Private method: \_onZoom. It applies a given zoom transform and sets the rounded zoom factor.
- `reset(): void` — Public method: reset. It resets the zoom to the initial scale and the origin (0,0).

### ZoomBaseDirective

File: `src/app/shared/zoom/zoom-base.directive.ts`
Standalone: yes

Description: The ZoomBase directive. It binds a d3 pan and zoom behaviour to the host element (scale extent from the zoom configuration) and syncs the zoom factor two-way via zoomValue (e.g., with a ZoomSliderComponent). Subclasses apply the resulting transform.

Inputs:
- `zoomConfig: ZoomConfig` — Readonly input signal: zoomConfig. It holds the zoom configuration (initial, min, max, step size).
- `zoomValue: number` — Readonly model signal: zoomValue. It holds the current zoom factor (rounded to the step size of the zoom configuration).

Outputs:
- `zoomValue: number` — Readonly model signal: zoomValue. It holds the current zoom factor (rounded to the step size of the zoom configuration).

Properties:
- `_elementRef: unknown = inject<ElementRef<E>>(ElementRef)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_elementRef. It keeps the reference to the host element.
- `_hostEl: unknown = this._elementRef.nativeElement` — Protected readonly variable: \_hostEl. It keeps the host element.
- `_selection: unknown = D3_SELECTION.select<E, unknown>(this._hostEl)` — Protected readonly variable: \_selection. It keeps the D3 selection of the host element.
- `_zoomBehaviour: unknown = D3_ZOOM.zoom<E, unknown>().on( 'zoom', (event: D3_ZOOM.D3ZoomEvent<E, unknown>) => this._onZoom(event.transform) )` — Protected readonly variable: \_zoomBehaviour. It keeps the D3 zoom behaviour bound to the host element.

Methods:
- `_applyTransform(transform: D3_ZOOM.ZoomTransform): void` — Protected abstract method: \_applyTransform. It applies a given zoom transform (e.g., to a target element or a signal).
- `_onZoom(transform: D3_ZOOM.ZoomTransform): void` — Private method: \_onZoom. It applies a given zoom transform and sets the rounded zoom factor.
- `reset(): void` — Public method: reset. It resets the zoom to the initial scale and the origin (0,0).

### EditionFolioDrawingService

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/services/edition-folio-drawing.service.ts`

Description: The EditionFolioDrawing service. It prepares the svg data of the edition folios and draws them into a given svg root group. The interaction with the drawn content segments is handled by the EditionFolioSegmentService.

Properties:
- `_contentSegmentOffsetCorrection: number = 4` — Private readonly variable: \_contentSegmentOffsetCorrection. It corrects the offset (in px) to avoid border collision between rendered SVG content segments.
- `_contentSegmentStrokeWidth: number = 2` — Private readonly variable: \_contentSegmentStrokeWidth. It keeps the stroke width for the content segments.
- `_folioSettings: FolioSettings = { factor: 1.5, formatX: 175, formatY: 270, initialOffsetX: 5, initialOffsetY: 5, }` — Private readonly variable: \_folioSettings. It keeps the default format settings for the folios.
- `_reversedRotationAngle: number = 180` — Private readonly variable: \_reversedRotationAngle. It keeps the rotation angle for a reversed item.

Methods:
- `_appendRect(parentSelection: D3Selection, rectangle: FolioSvgRectangle, cssClass: string): D3Selection` — Private method: \_appendRect. It appends a rect element for a given calculated rectangle to a given parent selection.
- `_appendSvgElementWithAttrs(parentSelection: D3Selection, type: string, attributes: Record<string, string | number>): D3Selection` — Private method: \_appendSvgElementWithAttrs. It appends an svg element of a given type with the given attributes to a given parent selection.
- `_drawContentSegmentLabel(segmentSelection: D3Selection, contentSegment: FolioSvgContentSegment): void` — Private method: \_drawContentSegmentLabel. It draws the (one- or two-line) label of a given content segment into a given content segment selection, rotated by 180 degrees around its center if the segment is reversed.
- `_drawContentSegments(sheetGroupSelection: D3Selection, folioSvgData: FolioSvgData): void` — Private method: \_drawContentSegments. It draws the content segments of the given folio svg data into a given sheet group: per content segment a focusable group (with the content segment bound as datum, link or button semantics and a title) containing a group with the segment polygon and the segment label.
- `_drawSheet(sheetGroupSelection: D3Selection, folioSvgData: FolioSvgData): void` — Private method: \_drawSheet. It draws the sheet of the given folio svg data into a given sheet group: the title, the sheet rectangle and (if given) the trademark.
- `_drawSystems(sheetGroupSelection: D3Selection, folioSvgData: FolioSvgData): void` — Private method: \_drawSystems. It draws the systems of the given folio svg data into a given sheet group: per system a group with its label (numbered in reverse if the systems are reversed) and a group with its lines.
- `_drawTrademark(sheetGroupSelection: D3Selection, trademarkRectangle: FolioSvgRectangle, systemsReversed: boolean): void` — Private method: \_drawTrademark. It draws the trademark into a given sheet group: a group with the trademark rectangle, the trademark symbol (rotated by 180 degrees if the systems are reversed) and a title.
- `_getContentSegmentAriaLabel(contentSegment: FolioSvgContentSegment, folioId: string): string` — Private method: \_getContentSegmentAriaLabel. It builds the aria label of a given content segment on a given folio, naming the action triggered by the segment.
- `getFolioSvgData(folio: Folio): FolioSvgData` — Public method: getFolioSvgData. It calculates the svg data (sheet, systems, content segments and viewbox) to render the svg of a given folio, based on its dimensions.
- `renderFolio(svgRootGroupSelection: D3Selection, folioSvgData: FolioSvgData): void` — Public method: renderFolio. It renders the given folio svg data into a given svg root group selection: it clears the content of the root group and draws the sheet, the systems and the content segments of the folio.

- `_getSvgGroupDataId(group: SVGGElement): string` — Private helper: \_getSvgGroupDataId. Returns the dataId for a given SVG group. Uses data-tkk-id if present (for multiple SVG refs to the same tkk entry), otherwise uses group id (default).
- `_getTkkOverlayColor(dataId: string, state: EditionSvgOverlaysState): string` — Private method: \_getTkkOverlayColor. It returns the color of the tkk overlays with the given data id for the given state.
- `createSvgOverlays(rootGroupSelection: D3Selection | undefined): EditionSvgOverlayTkk[]` — Public method: createSvgOverlays. It draws the overlay boxes for the tkk groups of the given SVG root group, makes tkk overlay boxes and link boxes keyboard accessible (focusable buttons/links), and returns the available tkk overlays.
- `createSvgOverlaysState(tkkOverlays: EditionSvgOverlayTkk[] = []): EditionSvgOverlaysState` — Public method: createSvgOverlaysState. It returns the initial state of the svg overlays with the given tkk overlays (nothing selected or hovered, highlighted).
- `getSelectedTkkOverlays(state: EditionSvgOverlaysState): EditionSvgOverlayTkk[]` — Public method: getSelectedTkkOverlays. It returns all selected tkk overlays of the given state (including all parts of multi-part overlays) in their original order.
- `getSvgOverlay(target: EventTarget | null): EditionSvgOverlay | undefined` — Public method: getSvgOverlay. It resolves the svg overlay (tkk overlay or link box overlay) hit by a given event target.
- `getTkkDataId(target: EventTarget | null): string | undefined` — Public method: getTkkDataId. It returns the data id of the tkk overlay hit by a given event target, if any.
- `setTkkOverlayHover(state: EditionSvgOverlaysState, dataId: string | undefined): EditionSvgOverlaysState` — Public method: setTkkOverlayHover. It returns the given state with the given data id as hovered tkk overlay (the same state if it is already hovered).
- `setTkkOverlaysHighlight(state: EditionSvgOverlaysState, isHighlighted: boolean): EditionSvgOverlaysState` — Public method: setTkkOverlaysHighlight. It returns the given state with the given highlighting of the tkk overlays (the same state if unchanged). Hiding the tkk overlays also clears their selection.
- `toggleTkkOverlaySelection(state: EditionSvgOverlaysState, dataId: string): EditionSvgOverlaysState` — Public method: toggleTkkOverlaySelection. It returns the given state with the selection of the tkk overlay(s) with the given data id toggled (added or removed).
- `updateTkkOverlays(rootGroupSelection: D3Selection | undefined, state: EditionSvgOverlaysState): void` — Public method: updateTkkOverlays. It updates the tkk overlay boxes according to the given state: it colors them (transparent if not highlighted, otherwise selected before hovered before default), sets their pressed state (aria-pressed) according to the selection, and disables not highlighted overlay boxes for pointer and keyboard interaction.

### ForceGraphCanvasService

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/canvas/force-graph-canvas.service.ts`

Description: The ForceGraphCanvas service. It draws the data of a force graph onto a canvas in a given view (by level of detail).

Methods:
- `_drawArrows(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, edges: ForceGraphEdge[]): void` — Private method: \_drawArrows. It draws an arrowhead at the target of each given (non-self) force graph edge, touching the target circle.
- `_drawEdgeLabels(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, edgeLabels: ForceGraphCanvasEdgeLabel[]): void` — Private method: \_drawEdgeLabels. It draws the given edge labels (the labels of the force graph edges at their positions).
- `_drawEdges(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, edges: ForceGraphEdge[]): void` — Private method: \_drawEdges. It draws all force graph edges as one path: straight lines from source to target and loops (rotated ellipses) for self edges.
- `_drawNodeCircles(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, nodes: ForceGraphVisibleNode[]): void` — Private method: \_drawNodeCircles. It draws the given nodes as one path of circles, filled and stroked with the current styles.
- `_drawNodeLabels(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, nodes: ForceGraphVisibleNode[]): void` — Private method: \_drawNodeLabels. It draws the label of each given node next to it: its short name (the label of the result node is shown in the tooltip).
- `_drawNodes(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, nodes: ForceGraphVisibleNode[], minCircleRadius: number): void` — Private method: \_drawNodes. It draws the given nodes, batched by fill color: as circles from the given minimum radius, smaller ones as squares of the same area.
- `_drawNodeSquares(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, nodes: ForceGraphVisibleNode[]): void` — Private method: \_drawNodeSquares. It draws the given nodes as one path of squares with the area of their circles, filled with the current style.
- `_prepareCanvas(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, view: ForceGraphCanvasView): void` — Private method: \_prepareCanvas. It clears the canvas and maps graph coordinates to canvas pixels: graph origin in the viewport center, then zoom, then device pixel ratio.
- `drawGraph(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, graphData: ForceGraphData, view: ForceGraphCanvasView): void` — Public method: drawGraph. It draws the items of the given force graph data touching the given view (also partly visible ones), by level of detail: arrowheads and labels only if not too many or too small, small nodes as squares.

### ForceGraphSimulationService

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation.service.ts`

Description: The ForceGraphSimulation service. It runs the force simulation of a graph in a web worker, or on the main thread without web workers or if the worker fails.

Properties:
- `_createWorker: unknown = inject(FORCE_GRAPH_SIMULATION_WORKER_FACTORY)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_createWorker. It keeps the injected factory of the web worker of the simulation.

Methods:
- `simulate(graphData: ForceGraphData, commands$: Observable<ForceGraphSimulationCommand>): Observable<ForceGraphSimulationProgress>` — Public method: simulate. It runs the steerable force simulation of the given data and emits every step's positions, endlessly (until unsubscribed). A failing worker falls back to the main thread; only a failure there errors.

### RdfStoreService

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/rdf-store/rdf-store.service.ts`

Description: The RdfStore service. It is the adapter to the rdfstore engine: it loads turtle data into a new in-memory store, executes SPARQL queries and converts the responses into RDF/JS terms. It is the only place that knows the rdfstore API and response formats.

Methods:
- `_createStore(): Promise<RdfStore>` — Private method: \_createStore. It creates a new in-memory store.
- `_error(message: string, cause?: unknown): Error` — Private method: \_error. It creates an Error with the given message, prefixed with the location of the service.
- `_execute(turtle: string, query: string): Promise<T>` — Private method: \_execute. It creates a new store, loads the turtle data and executes the query.
- `_literal(value: string, language?: string, datatype?: string): RdfTerm` — Private method: \_literal. It creates a literal with an optional language tag or datatype.
- `_load(store: RdfStore, turtle: string): Promise<number>` — Private method: \_load. It loads the given turtle data into the given store.
- `_nodeToTerm(node: RdfStoreNode): RdfTerm` — Private method: \_nodeToTerm. It converts a node of a CONSTRUCT response into an RDF/JS term.
- `_query(store: RdfStore, query: string): Promise<T>` — Private method: \_query. It executes the given query against the given store.
- `_stripBlankNodePrefix(value: string): string` — Private method: \_stripBlankNodePrefix. It removes the \_: prefix of a blank node value.
- `_toError(err: unknown, fallbackMessage: string): Error` — Private method: \_toError. It converts an unknown error of rdfstore into an Error with the location of the service. The original error is kept as cause .
- `_tokenToTerm(token: RdfStoreToken): RdfTerm` — Private method: \_tokenToTerm. It converts a token of a SELECT response into an RDF/JS term.
- `_toPredicate(term: RdfTerm): Quad_Predicate` — Private method: \_toPredicate. It narrows a term to a valid predicate (named node).
- `_toSubject(term: RdfTerm): Quad_Subject` — Private method: \_toSubject. It narrows a term to a valid subject (named node or blank node).
- `construct(turtle: string, query: string): Promise<Quad[]>` — Public method: construct. It executes a CONSTRUCT query against the given turtle data.
- `select(turtle: string, query: string): Promise<RdfStoreSelectResult>` — Public method: select. It executes a SELECT query against the given turtle data.

### SparqlQueryService

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/services/sparql-query.service.ts`

Description: The SparqlQuery service. It performs SPARQL queries against turtle data: it validates the turtle data, completes missing prefix declarations, dispatches the query by its type to the RdfStoreService and measures its duration.

Properties:
- `_lastTurtleParse: literal type | undefined` — Private variable: \_lastTurtleParse. It keeps the turtle data of the latest parse and its (pending) result, so that repeated runs against unchanged turtle data do not parse it again.
- `_rdfStoreService: unknown = inject(RdfStoreService)` — Private readonly injection variable: \_rdfStoreService. It keeps the instance of the injected RdfStoreService.

Methods:
- `_error(message: string, cause?: unknown): Error` — Private method: \_error. It creates an Error with the given message, prefixed with the location of the service.
- `_execute(query: string, turtle: string, prefixes: PrefixMap): Promise<SparqlResult>` — Private method: \_execute. It dispatches the given query by its type to the RdfStoreService.
- `_parseTurtleCached(turtle: string): Promise<TurtleParseResult>` — Private method: \_parseTurtleCached. It parses the given turtle data via parseTurtle, unless it is the same as in the latest parse (then it reuses that result).
- `_toPrefixMap(prefixes: Record<string | unknown> | undefined): PrefixMap` — Private method: \_toPrefixMap. It converts the prefixes of the n3 parser into a prefix map. The n3 parser provides the namespaces as strings at runtime, although they are typed as named nodes.
- `parseTurtle(turtle: string): Promise<TurtleParseResult>` — Public method: parseTurtle. It parses the given turtle data to validate it and to get its prefixes.
- `run(query: string, turtle: string): Promise<SparqlQueryRun>` — Public method: run. It performs a given SPARQL query against the given turtle data. Prefixes that are used, but not declared in the query, are declared from the turtle data or the default prefixes.

### StatisticsService

File: `src/app/views/statistics-view/services/statistics.service.ts`

Description: The Statistics service. It handles the calculation and provision of statistics for the edition outline data.

Methods:
- `_calculateCombinedProgressRate(progressRates: number[]): number` — Private method: \_calculateCombinedProgressRate. It calculates a rounded average value from a list of progress rates.
- `_calculateProgressRate(active: number, total: number): number` — Private method: \_calculateProgressRate. It calculates a progressrate from active and total values.
- `_incrementComplexCounters(targets: StatisticsComplexCounter[], complexType: StatisticsComplexType, isActive: boolean): void` — Private method: \_incrementComplexCounters. It registers one complex for all given statistics targets.
- `_isMnrX(complex: EditionOutlineComplexItem): boolean` — Private method: \_isMnrX. It checks whether a complex belongs to the MNR\_X category.
- `_processComplexes(stats: Statistics, seriesStats: StatisticsSeriesBreakdown, sectionStats: StatisticsSectionBreakdown, complexTypes: EditionOutlineComplexTypes | undefined): void` — Private method: \_processComplexes. It processes all complex types (opus, mnr, mnrX) for a section and updates all relevant statistics counters.
- `getStatisticsFromOutline(editionOutline: EditionOutlineSeries[]): Statistics` — Public method: calculateStatistics. It calculates comprehensive statistics from the edition outline data.

### ToastService

File: `src/app/shared/toast/toast.service.ts`

Description: The Toast service. It handles the displaying of toast messages.

Properties:
- `_toasts: unknown = signal<Toast[]>([])` — Private readonly signal: \_toasts. It holds the toast messages.
- `toasts: unknown = this._toasts.asReadonly()` — Readonly signal: toasts. It holds the toast messages (readonly).

Methods:
- `add(toast: Toast): void` — Public method: add. It adds the given toast to the toast array.
- `remove(toast: Toast): void` — Public method: remove. It removes the given toast from the toast array.
- `showMessage(toastMessage: ToastMessage, type: "error" | "info" = 'info'): void` — Public method: showMessage. It shows a given toast message with the specified type and logs it to the console.

## Guards

### editionComplexGuard

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-complex.guard.ts`

Description: Guard: editionComplexGuard. It lets the route complex/:complexId only match for known edition complexes and redirects unknown complex ids to the 404 page.

### editionComplexResolver

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-complex.resolver.ts`

Description: Resolver: editionComplexResolver. It resolves the edition complex of the route complex/:complexId and sets it as selected edition complex in the EditionStateService. The state is updated during the navigation (before the routed components are activated), so that all complex-dependent data is reset before any view reacts to the new complex.

### editionSectionGuard

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-outline/edition-sections/edition-section-detail/edition-section.guard.ts`

Description: Guard: editionSectionGuard. It lets the route section/:sectionId only activate for known sections of the given edition series and redirects unknown section ids to the 404 page. It is a CanActivate guard (and not a CanMatch guard), because the series id of the parent route is not available for matching inside the lazy loaded series routes.

### editionSectionResolver

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-outline/edition-sections/edition-section-detail/edition-section.resolver.ts`

Description: Resolver: editionSectionResolver. It resolves the edition section of the route section/:sectionId and sets it as selected edition section in the EditionStateService. It runs after the editionSeriesResolver of the parent route (which resets the section), so the route runs this resolver on every navigation ( runGuardsAndResolvers: 'always' ).

### editionSeriesGuard

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-outline/edition-series-detail/edition-series.guard.ts`

Description: Guard: editionSeriesGuard. It lets the route series/:seriesId only match for known edition series and redirects unknown series ids to the 404 page.

### editionSeriesResolver

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-outline/edition-series-detail/edition-series.resolver.ts`

Description: Resolver: editionSeriesResolver. It resolves the edition series of the route series/:seriesId and sets it as selected edition series in the EditionStateService (which also resets the selected edition complex and section). The route runs this resolver on every navigation ( runGuardsAndResolvers: 'always' ), so that a previously selected section is reset when navigating within the series. The section is set again afterwards by the editionSectionResolver of a child route.

### editionStateResetResolver

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-state-reset.resolver.ts`

Description: Resolver: editionStateResetResolver. It resets the selected edition complex, series and section in the EditionStateService for edition routes that do not belong to a specific complex, series or section (e.g. preface, row tables, series overview). The state is reset during the navigation (before the routed components are activated), analogous to the resolvers that set the state for complexes, series and sections.

### ForceGraphSimulationPin

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation-pin.ts`

Description: The ForceGraphSimulationPin class. It sends the pin and release commands of a dragged node to the simulation and keeps the node at its point locally (the results of the simulation arrive one round trip late).

Properties:
- `_pinned: literal type | undefined` — Private variable: \_pinned. It keeps the dragged node and its pin point, if any.
- `commands$: unknown = new Subject<ForceGraphSimulationCommand>()` — Readonly variable: commands$. It keeps the subject of the pin and release commands to the simulation.

Methods:
- `apply(): void` — Public method: apply. It moves the pinned node to its pin point, if any node is pinned (on the pin, and again after each result of the simulation).
- `pin(node: ForceGraphVisibleNode, point: ForceGraphPoint): void` — Public method: pin. It pins the given node at the given point: the simulation fixes it there (its neighbours follow), and it is moved there at once, since the results of the simulation arrive one round trip late.
- `release(node: ForceGraphVisibleNode): void` — Public method: release. It releases the given pinned node, so that the graph settles again.

## Interfaces

### AlertError

File: `src/app/shared/alert-error/alert-error.model.ts`

Description: The AlertError interface. It defines the structure of an error object displayed in an error alert.

Properties:
- `error: unknown` — The error itself (e.g., an Error, an HTTP error response or a message string).
- `key?: string` — The optional key of the error source (displayed as label).

### CanvasBounds

File: `src/app/shared/canvas/canvas.model.ts`

Description: The CanvasBounds interface. It represents an area of a canvas (in css pixels) by its smallest and largest corner.

Properties:
- `max: CanvasPoint` — The corner with the largest coordinates (bottom right).
- `min: CanvasPoint` — The corner with the smallest coordinates (top left).

### CanvasDragGesture

File: `src/app/shared/canvas/drag/canvas-drag.model.ts`

Description: The CanvasDragGesture interface. It represents the found subject of a d3 drag gesture and the flag if it has been moved, wrapped without x/y (d3 then reports canvas coordinates).

Properties:
- `isMoved: boolean` — The flag if the subject has been moved during the gesture (a gesture without move is no drag, e.g., a click).
- `subject: T` — The found drag subject.

### CanvasDragMove

File: `src/app/shared/canvas/drag/canvas-drag.model.ts`

Description: The CanvasDragMove interface. It represents a move of a drag gesture on a canvas.

Properties:
- `point: CanvasPoint` — The current point of the pointer on the canvas.
- `subject: T` — The dragged subject.

### CanvasFrameScheduler

File: `src/app/shared/canvas/canvas.model.ts`

Description: The CanvasFrameScheduler interface. It represents a scheduler that runs a callback at most once per animation frame.

Properties:
- `schedule: function` — It requests one run of the callback in the next animation frame (several requests are coalesced).

### CanvasPoint

File: `src/app/shared/canvas/canvas.model.ts`

Description: The CanvasPoint interface. It represents a point of a canvas (in css pixels, relative to the top left corner of the canvas).

Properties:
- `x: number` — The x coordinate.
- `y: number` — The y coordinate.

### CanvasSize

File: `src/app/shared/canvas/canvas.model.ts`

Description: The CanvasSize interface. It represents the rendered size of a canvas (in css pixels).

Properties:
- `height: number` — The height of the canvas in css pixels.
- `width: number` — The width of the canvas in css pixels.

### CanvasViewport

Extends: `CanvasSize`

Properties:
- `dpr: number` — The device pixel ratio (backing store pixels per css pixel).
- `height: number` — The height of the canvas in css pixels.
- `width: number` — The width of the canvas in css pixels.

### ExpandAllState

File: `src/app/shared/button-expand-all/button-expand-all.utils.ts`

Description: The ExpandAllState interface. It describes the open state of a group of expandable items (e.g. \<details\> elements) that can be toggled individually or all at once via the ButtonExpandAllComponent.

Properties:
- `allOpen: Signal<boolean>` — Readonly computed signal: allOpen. It holds true if all items of the group are open.

Methods:
- `isOpen(key: K): boolean` — Method: isOpen. It checks whether the item with the given key is open.
- `setAll(open: boolean): void` — Method: setAll. It sets the open state of all items of the group.
- `setOpen(key: K, open: boolean): void` — Method: setOpen. It sets the open state of the item with the given key.

### ForceGraphCanvasLimits

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/canvas/force-graph-canvas.model.ts`

Description: The ForceGraphCanvasLimits interface. It represents the level-of-detail limits of the drawing: by number in view ( MAX\_… ) and by size on the screen ( MIN\_… , in css pixels: graph units times the zoom factor).

Properties:
- `MAX_ARROWS: number` — The maximum number of arrowheads touching the view that are drawn.
- `MAX_LABELS: number` — The maximum number of node labels (and of edge labels) touching the view that are drawn.
- `MIN_ARROW_SCREEN_LENGTH: number` — The minimum length of an arrowhead on the screen from which arrowheads are drawn.
- `MIN_EDGE_LABEL_SCREEN_SIZE: number` — The minimum font size of an edge label on the screen from which edge labels are drawn.
- `MIN_NODE_CIRCLE_SCREEN_RADIUS: number` — The minimum radius of a node on the screen from which it is drawn as circle (in large graphs).
- `MIN_NODE_LABEL_SCREEN_SIZE: number` — The minimum font size of a node label on the screen from which node labels are drawn (below the one of edge labels: node labels stay longer for orientation).

### ForceGraphCanvasStyles

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/canvas/force-graph-canvas.model.ts`

Description: The ForceGraphCanvasStyles interface. It represents the styles of the drawn graph. Sizes are in graph units (scaled with the zoom).

Properties:
- `ARROW_FILL: string` — The fill color of the arrowheads.
- `ARROW_LENGTH: number` — The length of an arrowhead from its tip (at the target circle) to its base.
- `ARROW_WIDTH: number` — The half width of the base of an arrowhead.
- `EDGE_LABEL_FILL: string` — The fill color of the edge labels.
- `EDGE_LABEL_FONT: string` — The font of the edge labels.
- `EDGE_LABEL_FONT_SIZE: number` — The font size of the edge labels (also used for their area in view).
- `EDGE_LABEL_OFFSET: ForceGraphPoint` — The offset of the baseline start of an edge label from the center of its edge.
- `EDGE_STROKE: string` — The stroke color of the edges.
- `EDGE_STROKE_WIDTH: number` — The stroke width of the edges.
- `LABEL_CHAR_WIDTH: number` — The estimated maximum width of a label character as share of the font size (rather too wide, so that no partly visible label is left out).
- `LOOP_RADIUS_X: number` — The radius of the loop of a self edge along its major axis.
- `LOOP_RADIUS_Y: number` — The radius of the loop of a self edge along its minor axis.
- `LOOP_ROTATION: number` — The rotation of the major axis of the loop of a self edge (in radians, negative: upwards).
- `NODE_FILL: Readonly<Record<ResultGraphNodeKind, string>>` — The fill color of the node circles per kind of node.
- `NODE_LABEL_FILL: string` — The fill color of the node labels.
- `NODE_LABEL_FONT: string` — The font of the node labels.
- `NODE_LABEL_FONT_SIZE: number` — The font size of the node labels (also used for their area in view).
- `NODE_LABEL_OFFSET: ForceGraphPoint` — The offset of the baseline start of a node label from the center of its node.
- `NODE_STROKE: string` — The stroke color of the node circles.
- `NODE_STROKE_WIDTH: number` — The stroke width of the node circles.
- `SELF_EDGE_LABEL_OFFSET: ForceGraphPoint` — The offset of the baseline start of a self edge label from its node (above the loop).

### ForceGraphCanvasView

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/canvas/force-graph-canvas.model.ts`

Description: The ForceGraphCanvasView interface. It represents the current view onto the graph: the zoom transform and the viewport of the canvas.

Properties:
- `transform: ZoomTransform` — The zoom transform.
- `viewport: CanvasViewport` — The viewport of the canvas (size and device pixel ratio).

### ForceGraphD3SimulationNode

Extends: `SimulationNodeDatum`

Description: The ForceGraphD3SimulationNode interface. It represents a node of the D3 force simulation of a layout (only radius and position).
