### ForceGraphData

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/force-graph.model.ts`

Description: The ForceGraphData interface. It represents the data of a force graph: the nodes (with their positions) and edges to be laid out and drawn.

Properties:
- `edges: ForceGraphEdge[]` — The edges with their nodes.
- `nodes: ForceGraphNode[]` — All nodes (the visible nodes and the middle nodes of edges that have one).
- `visibleNodes: ForceGraphVisibleNode[]` — The visible nodes, i.e. the nodes of the result graph (without the middle nodes of edges).

### ForceGraphEdge

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/force-graph.model.ts`

Description: The ForceGraphEdge interface. It represents an edge of the result graph with its force graph nodes.

Properties:
- `mid?: ForceGraphNode` — The invisible middle node of the edge (only for self edges and repeated edges between the same two nodes).
- `resultEdge: ResultGraphEdge` — The edge of the result graph.
- `source: ForceGraphVisibleNode` — The visible node of the source.
- `target: ForceGraphVisibleNode` — The visible node of the target.

### ForceGraphNode

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/force-graph.model.ts`
Extends: `ForceGraphPoint`

Description: The ForceGraphNode interface. It represents a node of the force simulation: a visible node or the invisible middle node of an edge.

Properties:
- `id: string` — The unique id of the node.
- `radius: number` — The radius of the node (drawn for a visible node); the charge force of the simulation uses radius - 1 .
- `x: number` — The x coordinate (writable, unlike that of a point; NaN until the node is laid out).
- `y: number` — The y coordinate (writable, unlike that of a point; NaN until the node is laid out).

### ForceGraphPoint

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/force-graph.model.ts`

Description: The ForceGraphPoint interface. It represents a point in graph coordinates (origin in the center of the graph).

Properties:
- `x: number` — The x coordinate.
- `y: number` — The y coordinate.

### ForceGraphSimulation

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation.model.ts`

Description: The ForceGraphSimulation interface. It represents a running force simulation (in a web worker or on the main thread) that can be steered while it runs.

Properties:
- `dispose: function` — Stops the simulation.
- `pin: function` — Fixes the node with the given index at the given point and keeps the simulation warm (its neighbours follow).
- `release: function` — Frees the node with the given index, so that the simulation cools down again.

### ForceGraphSimulationConfig

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation.model.ts`

Description: The ForceGraphSimulationConfig interface. It represents the configuration of the force simulation: its alphas, its pace and the forces per graph size.

Properties:
- `ALPHA_CALM: number` — The alpha below which the layout only moves gently and may cool down visibly (above ALPHA\_MIN ).
- `ALPHA_MIN: number` — The alpha below which the simulation rests (D3 default: 0.001).
- `ALPHA_REHEAT: number` — The start alpha of a relayout (most nodes keep their positions).
- `ALPHA_TARGET_DRAG: number` — The alpha target while a node is pinned (D3 default: 0.3; above ALPHA\_MIN ).
- `COLLISION_STRENGTH: number` — The strength of the collision force, 0–1 (D3 default: 0.7).
- `GRAVITY_STRENGTH: number` — The strength of the weak pull of each node towards the center (keeps unconnected parts close).
- `LARGE_GRAPH: ForceGraphSimulationForces` — The forces of large graphs (denser and cheaper layout; a tick takes longer than one frame).
- `PROGRESS_INTERVAL_MS: number` — The time between two steps of the simulation in milliseconds (about one animation frame).
- `SMALL_GRAPH: ForceGraphSimulationForces` — The forces of small graphs (spacious layout with room for the labels).

### ForceGraphSimulationForces

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation.model.ts`

Description: The ForceGraphSimulationForces interface. It represents the tuning of the D3 forces and the cooling down for one graph size (small or large).

Properties:
- `CHARGE_STRENGTH: number` — The charge per radius unit of a node (negative: repulsion; D3 default: -30).
- `CHARGE_THETA: number` — The accuracy of the approximation of the charge force (D3 default: 0.9; higher is coarser).
- `COLLISION_ITERATIONS: number` — The number of iterations of the collision force per tick.
- `COLLISION_PADDING: number` — The padding added to the radius of a node for its collision radius.
- `INITIAL_STEP_TICKS: number` — The maximum number of ticks per step of the initial layout, which paces its visible cooling down ( Infinity : as many ticks as fit into one step).
- `LINK_DISTANCE: number` — The distance of linked nodes (D3 default: 30).
- `RELEASE_TICKS: number` — The number of ticks until the layout has cooled down after a release of a dragged node.
- `TICKS: number` — The number of ticks until the layout has cooled down (D3 default: 300).

### ForceGraphSimulationInput

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation.model.ts`

Description: The ForceGraphSimulationInput interface. It represents the structured-cloneable input of a simulation (posted to a web worker), indexed like the nodes.

Properties:
- `isRelayout: boolean` — The flag if at least half of the nodes keep a previous position (starts with a lower alpha to keep them).
- `links: Int32Array` — The links as pairs of node indices (source, target, ...); an edge with a middle node has two.
- `positions: Float32Array` — The known positions of the nodes as pairs (x, y, x, y, ...); NaN for unknown positions.
- `radii: Float32Array` — The radius of each force graph node.

### ForceGraphSimulationProgress

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation.model.ts`

Description: The ForceGraphSimulationProgress interface. It represents a result of a force graph simulation (reported after every step).

Properties:
- `isCalm: boolean` — The flag if the layout only moves gently anymore (alpha below ALPHA\_CALM ) or has settled.
- `positions: Float32Array` — The positions of the nodes as pairs (x, y, x, y, ...), indexed like the simulation input.

### ForceGraphSimulationScheduler

File: `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation.model.ts`

Description: The ForceGraphSimulationScheduler interface. It represents the clock and the timer that pace the steps of a force simulation.

Properties:
- `now: function` — The current time in milliseconds.
- `schedule: function` — Schedules the given callback after the given delay and returns a function that cancels it.

## Public functions

- `_alpha(d3Simulation: ForceGraphD3Simulation): number` — Private utils method: \_alpha. It gets the alpha of the given simulation; an empty simulation has nothing to move (alpha 0: settled from the start).
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation.utils.ts`
- `_createD3Simulation(nodes, links, forces: ForceGraphSimulationForces, alphaDecay: number, isRelayout: boolean): ForceGraphD3Simulation` — Private utils method: \_createD3Simulation. It creates the stopped D3 force simulation (charge, centering, gravity, collision and link force) of the given simulation nodes and links with the given forces.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation.utils.ts`
- `_createSimulationWorker(): Worker | undefined` — Private function: \_createSimulationWorker. It creates the web worker of the force graph simulation, if web workers are available and the worker can be created (e.g., not blocked by a content security policy).
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation.service.ts`
- `_findClosingBrace(code: string, openIndex: number): number` — Private utils method: \_findClosingBrace. It finds the index of the brace closing the brace at a given index of a given masked query.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/utils/sparql.utils.ts`
- `_findD3Node(d3Nodes, index: number): ForceGraphD3SimulationNode | undefined` — Private utils method: \_findD3Node. It finds the simulation node at the given index, if it is a valid index of the given simulation nodes (the index of a command comes from a worker message).
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation.utils.ts`
- `_findKeyword(code: string, keywords, fromIndex: number = 0): number` — Private utils method: \_findKeyword. It finds the index of the first of the given keywords in a given masked query.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/utils/sparql.utils.ts`
- `_fixNode(d3Nodes, index: number, point?: ForceGraphPoint): boolean` — Private utils method: \_fixNode. It fixes the node at the given index (if valid) at once at the given point, or frees it without a point.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation.utils.ts`
- `_isSettled(d3Simulation: ForceGraphD3Simulation): boolean` — Private utils method: \_isSettled. It checks if the given simulation has settled (alpha below ALPHA\_MIN ). A pinned node keeps alpha near ALPHA\_TARGET\_DRAG , so a simulation with a pinned node never settles.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation.utils.ts`
- `_keywordRegex(keywords, flags: string = ''): RegExp` — Private utils method: \_keywordRegex. It creates a case-insensitive regex for the given keywords, not being part of a (prefixed) name or a variable (e.g. ex:load , ?copy , PREFIX add: ).
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/utils/sparql.utils.ts`
- `_literalKey(literal: Literal): string` — Private utils method: \_literalKey. It creates the key of a given literal in N-Triples-like notation.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/utils/term.utils.ts`
- `_nodePairKey(sourceId: string, targetId: string): string` — Private utils method: \_nodePairKey. It creates a key of the pair of nodes of an edge, regardless of the direction of the edge.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/force-graph.utils.ts`
- `_onSimulationMessage(data: MessageEvent<ForceGraphSimulationMessage>): void` — Private function: \_onSimulationMessage. It starts the simulation on start (posting each step's progress back, positions transferred) and forwards pin and release to it.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation.worker.ts`
- `_runTicks(d3Simulation: ForceGraphD3Simulation, maxTicks: number, scheduler: ForceGraphSimulationScheduler): number` — Private utils method: \_runTicks. It ticks the given simulation at least once, until it has settled, the given number of ticks is done or the interval ( PROGRESS\_INTERVAL\_MS ) is used up.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation.utils.ts`
- `_startWorkerSimulation(worker: Worker, input: ForceGraphSimulationInput, onProgress, onFailure): ForceGraphSimulation` — Private function: \_startWorkerSimulation. It starts the simulation in the given web worker and passes on its progress; pin and release are posted to it. A failing worker (e.g., script not loaded, failed step) is terminated, like on dispose, and reported.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation.service.ts`
- `_toAlphaDecay(alphaStart: number, ticks: number): number` — Private utils method: \_toAlphaDecay. It gets the alpha decay that cools a simulation down from the given start alpha to the minimum alpha within the given number of ticks.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation.utils.ts`
- `_toD3SimulationLinks(links: Int32Array): ForceGraphD3SimulationLink[]` — Private utils method: \_toD3SimulationLinks. It creates the links of the simulation from the given pairs of node indices.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation.utils.ts`
- `_toD3SimulationNodes(radii: Float32Array, positions: Float32Array): ForceGraphD3SimulationNode[]` — Private utils method: \_toD3SimulationNodes. It creates the simulation nodes from the given radii and positions; nodes without a known position (NaN) are placed by d3 (phyllotaxis arrangement).
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation.utils.ts`
- `_toLimitValue(index: number): number` — Private function: \_toLimitValue. It gets the limit value (number of triples) at the given index of the sequence 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000, 2500, ...
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/limit/force-graph-limit.component.ts`
- `_toLimitValues(tripleCount: number): number[]` — Private function: \_toLimitValues. It derives the possible limit values (number of triples) of the force graph that are below the given triple count.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/limit/force-graph-limit.component.ts`
- `_toLinkIndices(edges, nodes): Int32Array` — Private utils method: \_toLinkIndices. It converts the given force graph edges into links between consecutive force graph nodes of their paths (two links via the middle node of an edge that has one), as pairs of node indices.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation-transfer.utils.ts`
- `_toMidNode(pairKey: string, edgeNumber: number): ForceGraphNode` — Private utils method: \_toMidNode. It creates the invisible middle node (without position) of the given edge number between the given node pair, keyed by both (stable when the graph grows or shrinks).
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/force-graph.utils.ts`
- `_toNodeKind(draft: ResultGraphNodeDraft): ResultGraphNodeKind` — Private utils method: \_toNodeKind. It determines the kind of a graph node from its draft.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/result-graph.utils.ts`
- `_toVisibleNode(resultNode: ResultGraphNode): ForceGraphVisibleNode` — Private utils method: \_toVisibleNode. It creates the visible node of the given node of the result graph (without position).
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/force-graph.utils.ts`
- `addMissingPrefixes(query: string, prefixes: PrefixMap): { query: string; unknownPrefixes: string[] }` — Utils method: addMissingPrefixes. It prepends the declarations of all prefixes that are used, but not declared in a given SPARQL query, if they are known.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/utils/prefix.utils.ts`
- `applyAbbreviations(root: HTMLElement): void` — Utils method: applyAbbreviations. It replaces abbreviation matches in an element's text nodes with elements.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/shared/abbr/abbr.utils.ts`
- `calculateContentSegment(content: ValidFolioContent, folioSystemsLayout: FolioSystemsLayout, segmentOffsetCorrection: number): FolioSvgContentSegment` — Method: calculateContentSegment. It calculates a content segment (polygon vertices, label and its center) of a given valid folio content.

- `calculateContentSegmentX(segment: FolioSegment, startX: FolioSystemsLayout, systemsWidth: unknown, segmentSplit: number, offsetCorrection: number, isStart: boolean): number` — Method: calculateContentSegmentX. It calculates the x value of the start or end vertices of a content segment.

  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/canvas/force-graph-canvas.utils.ts`
- `toConstructQuery(query: string): string | null` — Utils method: toConstructQuery. It converts a given SELECT query into the short form of a CONSTRUCT query ( CONSTRUCT WHERE { triples } ) with the same pattern (case-insensitive). The projection is dropped, solution modifiers (GROUP BY, ORDER BY, LIMIT etc.) are kept. Queries whose pattern is not a plain triples pattern (with FILTER, OPTIONAL etc., nested groups or property paths) are not converted.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/utils/sparql.utils.ts`
- `toForceGraphData(graph: ResultGraph): ForceGraphData` — Utils method: toForceGraphData. It converts the given result graph into unpositioned force graph data. Self and repeated edges get an invisible middle node spacing them out (keyed by node pair, so restored positions match).
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/force-graph.utils.ts`
- `toFullSheetId(id, partial?: string): string` — Function: toFullSheetId. It joins a given sheet id and an (optional) partial id to the full sheet id (as used in the URL).
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/utils/edition-sheets.utils.ts`
- `toGraphPoint(point: CanvasPoint, view: ForceGraphCanvasView): ForceGraphPoint` — Utils method: toGraphPoint. It converts a given point of the canvas (in css pixels) into graph coordinates.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/canvas/force-graph-canvas.utils.ts`
- `toResultGraph(quads, prefixes: PrefixMap): ResultGraph` — Utils method: toResultGraph. It converts the given quads into the graph view model: one node per distinct subject or object (by term key), one edge per quad (from subject to object, labeled by the predicate), the kind of a node from its term type and rdf:type statements (precedence: class, blank, literal, instance, resource).
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/result-graph.utils.ts`
- `toSelectQuery(query: string): string | null` — Utils method: toSelectQuery. It converts a given CONSTRUCT query into a SELECT query ( SELECT \* ) with the same pattern, dropping an explicit construct template (case-insensitive).
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/utils/sparql.utils.ts`
- `toSimulationInput(graphData: ForceGraphData): ForceGraphSimulationInput` — Utils method: toSimulationInput. It converts the given force graph data into the structured-cloneable input of a simulation: radii, positions and links (as node indices, via middle nodes) of the force graph nodes.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation-transfer.utils.ts`
- `toSvgSheetSelection(sheet: EditionSvgSheet, content: EditionSvgSheetContent): EditionSvgSheetSelection` — Function: toSvgSheetSelection. It creates the selection of a given svg sheet with a given (selected) content.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/utils/edition-sheets.utils.ts`
- `toTableCell(term: RdfTerm, prefixes: PrefixMap): SelectTableCell` — Utils method: toTableCell. It converts a given RDF term into a cell of the SPARQL results table: IRIs and blank nodes are labeled by their short name, literals by their exact lexical value (integers are not converted to numbers to keep values beyond the safe-integer range; the natural sort order of the table still sorts digit strings numerically).
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/select/table/select-table.utils.ts`
- `toTableRows(result: SparqlSelectResult): TableRow[]` — Utils method: toTableRows. It converts the bindings of a given SELECT result into rows of the SPARQL results table, with one cell per bound variable. Unbound variables get no cell.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/select/table/select-table.utils.ts`
- `toViewBounds(view: ForceGraphCanvasView): ForceGraphBounds` — Utils method: toViewBounds. It gets the area of the canvas in view in graph coordinates.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/canvas/force-graph-canvas.utils.ts`
- `unpackPositions(positions: Float32Array, nodes): void` — Utils method: unpackPositions. It unpacks the given positions (pairs: x, y, x, y, ...) into the given force graph nodes of the same index.
  Defined in `src/app/views/edition-view/edition-outlets/edition-complex/edition-detail/edition-graph/graph-visualizer/results/construct/force-graph/simulation/force-graph-simulation-transfer.utils.ts`

- `type CanvasZoomFilter = function` — The CanvasZoomFilter type. It represents an extra filter for the events that may start a pan (e.g., not a pointer-down on a node).
- `type CmMode = StreamParser<unknown>` — The CmMode type. It represents the mode of a codemirror editor object.
- `type D3Selection = Selection<any | any | any | any>` — The D3Selection type. It represents the selection of a d3 element.
- `type EditionCatalogueTypeConstantsKey = keyof typeof EDITION_CATALOGUE_TYPE_CONSTANTS` — The EditionCatalogueTypeConstantsKey type. It is used in the context of the edition view to store the keys of the edition catalogue type constants.

- `type EditionComplexJsonData = Partial<Record<string, { titleStatement: { title: string; catalogueType: string; catalogueNumber: string }; respStatement: { editors: EditionComplexJsonPersonRe…` — The EditionComplexJsonData type. It is used in the context of the edition view to describe the structure of a JSON data for an edition complex (an object with the complex id as its only key).
- `type EditionComplexPlaceholderType = keyof typeof EDITION_COMPLEX_PLACEHOLDER_SUBJECTS` — The EditionComplexPlaceholderType type. It represents the type of an edition complex placeholder.
- `type EditionDataAssetsKeys = EditionStaticDataAssetsKeys | EditionComplexDataAssetsKeys` — The EditionDataAssetsKeys type. It defines the valid keys for any data assets used in the EditionDataService.
- `type EditionRouteConstantsKey = keyof typeof EDITION_ROUTE_CONSTANTS` — The EditionRouteConstantsKey type. It is used in the context of the edition view to store the keys of the edition route constants.
- `type EditionStaticDataAssetsKeys = "preface" | "rowtables"` — The EditionStaticDataAssetsKeys type. It defines the valid keys for the static data assets used in the EditionDataService.
- `type EditionSvgOverlay = EditionSvgOverlayTkk | EditionSvgOverlayLinkBox` — The EditionSvgOverlay type. It describes an svg overlay of an svg sheet: a tkk overlay or a link box overlay.
- `type EditionTypeKey = keyof typeof EDITION_TYPE_LABEL_MAP` — The EditionTypeKey type. It is used in the context of the edition view to define a valid key for a single edition type.
- `type EditionTypeLabel = typeof EDITION_TYPE_LABEL_MAP['EditionTypeKey']` — The EditionTypeLabel type. It is used in the context of the edition view to define a valid label for a single edition type.
- `type EditionViewContext = KnownViewContexts | DynamicViewContexts` — The EditionViewContext type. It defines the structure of the context for the edition view.
- `type EditionViewDataContent = unknown` — The EditionViewDataContent type. It defines the structure of the data content for a specific edition view key.
- `type EditionViewKey = keyof EditionViewDataTypeMapping` — The EditionViewKey type. It defines the valid keys for the edition view data.
- `type ForceGraphD3Simulation = Simulation<ForceGraphD3SimulationNode | undefined>` — The ForceGraphD3Simulation type. It represents the D3 force simulation of the simulation nodes (steered via a ForceGraphSimulation).
- `type ForceGraphD3SimulationLink = SimulationLinkDatum<ForceGraphD3SimulationNode>` — The ForceGraphD3SimulationLink type. It represents a link of the D3 force simulation between two simulation nodes (by index).
- `type ForceGraphSimulationCommand = literal type | literal type` — The ForceGraphSimulationCommand type. It represents a command to a running simulation: pin fixes a dragged node at a point, release frees it.
- `type ForceGraphSimulationMessage = literal type | literal type | literal type` — The ForceGraphSimulationMessage type. It represents a message to the simulation worker: start an input, pin and release a node by index.
- `type ForceGraphSimulationWorkerFactory = function` — The ForceGraphSimulationWorkerFactory type. It represents a factory of the simulation web worker (undefined if web workers are not available or the worker cannot be created).
- `type GraphQueryType = "select" | "construct" | "ask" | "describe" | "update" | null` — The GraphQueryType type. It is used in the context of the edition view to store the type of a graph query from a graph json file.
- `type HomeViewCardLink = HomeViewCardInternalLink | HomeViewCardExternalLink` — The HomeViewCardLink type. It is used in the context of the home view to define the type for the link of a home view card.
- `type KnownViewContexts = literal type | literal type | literal type` — The KnownViewContexts type. It defines the structure of the known contexts for edition views.
- `type LogoKeys = "angular" | "awg" | "bootstrap" | "github" | "gnd" | "orcid" | "sagw" | "snf" | "sparql" | "unibas" | "viaf"` — The LogoKeys type. It defines the valid keys for the logos used in the app.
- `type Logos = Record<LogoKeys | Logo>` — The Logos type. It defines a dictionary of logo objects, mapped by the valid LogoKeys.
- `type ModalType = "text" | "image"` — The ModalType type. It defines the possible types of modal data, either 'text' or 'image'.
- `type PrefixMap = Readonly<Record<string, string>>` — The PrefixMap type. It represents a map of prefix names to namespace IRIs, e.g. { awg: 'https://edition.anton-webern.ch/webern-onto#' } .
- `type RdfStoreSelectResponse = Record<string, RdfStoreToken | null>[]` — The RdfStoreSelectResponse type. It represents the SELECT response of rdfstore: one row per solution, with null for unbound variables.
- `type RdfTerm = NamedNode | BlankNode | Literal` — The RdfTerm type. It represents an RDF term of a triple or a SPARQL binding, based on the RDF/JS data model ( https://rdf.js.org/data-model-spec/ ). Variables and the default graph are not part of query results, so they are excluded.
- `type ResultGraphNodeKind = "resource" | "class" | "instance" | "blank" | "literal"` — The ResultGraphNodeKind type. It represents the kind of a graph node, derived from the RDF terms: class : object of an rdf:type statement, instance : subject of an rdf:type statement, blank : blank node, literal : literal value, resource : any other IRI.
- `type SelectTableCellType = "uri" | "bnode" | "literal"` — The SelectTableCellType type. It represents the type of a table cell, named as in the SPARQL 1.1 Query Results JSON Format.
- `type SourceDescDetailsKey = "titles" | "dates" | "paginations" | "measureNumbers" | "instrumentations" | "annotations"` — The SourceDescDetailsKey type. It is used in the context of the edition view to name the keys of the physical description of a source description that are displayed as simple details sections.
- `type SourceSiglum = Pick<Source | "siglum" | "siglumAddendum" | "missing">` — The SourceSiglum type. It stores the data needed to display the siglum of a source (siglum, addendum and missing flag).
- `type SparqlBinding = Readonly<Record<string, RdfTerm>>` — The SparqlBinding type. It represents a single solution of a SPARQL SELECT query as a map of variable names to RDF terms. Unbound variables (e.g. from OPTIONAL) are missing.
- `type SparqlQueryRequest = Readonly<Pick<GraphQuery, "queryType" | "queryString">> & literal type` — The SparqlQueryRequest type. It represents a request to run a SPARQL query against given triples.
- `type SparqlResult = SparqlConstructResult | SparqlSelectResult | SparqlUnsupportedResult` — The SparqlResult type. It represents the result of a SPARQL query, discriminated by its kind . Empty results are represented by empty arrays; errors are thrown.
- `type StatisticsComplexBreakdownData = Pick<StatisticsBreakdownBase | "activeComplexBreakdown" | "complexBreakdown" | "totalComplexes">` — The StatisticsComplexBreakdownData type. It defines the structure for the complex breakdown data used in the statistics view, by picking the relevant properties from the StatisticsBreakdownBase class.
- `type StatisticsComplexType = keyof StatisticsComplexBreakdown` — The StatisticsComplexType type. It defines the valid complex types for statistics breakdowns.
- `type StatisticsOverallProgressData = Pick<StatisticsBreakdownBase | "progressRate" | "activeComplexes" | "totalComplexes">` — The StatisticsOverallProgressData type. It defines the structure for the overall progress data used in the statistics view, by picking the relevant properties from the StatisticsBreakdownBase class.
- `type StatisticsProgressBarConfig = literal type | literal type | literal type` — The StatisticsProgressBarConfig type. It defines the valid configuration options for the StatisticsProgressBarComponent, including different modes for percentage, ratio, and absolute values.
- `type StatisticsSummaryData = Pick<Statistics | "activeSeries" | "activeSections" | "activeComplexes" | "totalComplexes">` — The StatisticsSummaryData type. It defines the structure for the summary data used in the statistics view, by picking the relevant properties from the Statistics class.
- `type TableRow = Readonly<Partial<Record<string, TableCell>>>` — The TableRow type. It represents a row of a table with one cell per column (header label); a row can have no cell for a column.
- `type ValidFolioContent = FolioContent & literal type` — Type: ValidFolioContent. A folio content with its segments (checked by isValidFolioContent).
